title: Moments of polynomial processes under affine resetting
summary: We consider polynomial processes, i.e., continuous-time Markov processes that preserve polynomials without increasing degree, and augment them with resetting. Resetting means that at the jump times of an indepen- dent renewal process, the polynomial process is instantaneously reset to a new state, which can be chosen deterministically, randomly or in state-dependent fashion.
